text: The Thessaly Weir diverts the Morrow River, according to the Kestrel County Water Authority, which said the structure has been operating at full capacity since Tuesday’s reopening after a month of repairs. Authority director Elin Voss said the weir is redirecting an average of 42 million gallons a day into the South Delta canal to support irrigation for farms near Briar Point. Crews replaced two gates and cleared silt from the intake basin during the shutdown. County engineers said downstream flows on the Morrow remain within seasonal limits, though anglers reported slower current near Latchford Bend. The authority said it will monitor the diversion through the end of the dry season.
